title: Weekly Planning-to-Execution Lag
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:ops plan_bucket=* planned_epoch=* first_done_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((first_done_epoch-planned_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by plan_bucket
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures planning-to-execution lag by plan bucket for weekly planning.
value: Lag tracking shows which plan bucket create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside weekly planning.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `planning-to-execution lag` on `lifeos:ops` events and aggregate them by `plan_bucket`.
visualization: Table of plan bucket with average and worst planning-to-execution lag.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how long things take for each plan bucket so you can see where weekly planning slows down.
